## Goal
- Establish and prove bounded, approval-gated IVX self-healing with continuous scanning, durable incidents, safe repair flow, SHA-parity deployment verification, crash recovery, and controlled certification without unauthorized production mutation.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use only `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`; treat protected `main` as production.
- Never deploy production automatically or mutate production infrastructure without required owner approval.
- Do not modify production secrets, databases/RLS, authentication, payments, AWS/DNS/Render/Supabase, signing, or destructive data without explicit owner approval.
- Never edit `main` directly; isolate one incident per `auto-fix/<incident-id>` branch and PR.
- Safe autonomous scope: TypeScript/lint/import/test/workflow/UI/loading/cache/retry/duplicate-request repairs.
- Required workflows: `IVX CI`, `IVX QA Suite`, `IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline`, `Android Emulator QA`, and `iOS Simulator QA`.
- Do not claim zero crashes, unmeasured response times, completed certification, active monitoring, rollback, or production verification without evidence.
- Final acceptance string may only be returned after all requested monitoring, persistence, controlled-test, workflow, SHA-parity, restart-recovery, mobile-evidence, and owner-control requirements are proven.

## Progress
### Done
- Historical GitHub Actions billing/spending blocker was reportedly resolved:
  ```text
  Product=Actions
  budget=$20
  Stop usage=Yes
  ```
- Historical `IVX CI` run `30762630846`, attempt `3`, reportedly obtained GitHub-hosted runners and ran against:
  ```text
  012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Historical `IVX CI` attempt `3` reportedly passed secret scan, backend tests, and chat/intent/performance tests.
- Available root and `recovery/canonical-main` checkouts report:
  ```text
  ## main...origin/main [ahead 1]
  42fd09aec234452527c394d6602d50e9a1ae1c5c HEAD -> main
  ```
- `/readiness` currently returns HTTP 200:
  ```json
  {"ok":true,"ready":true,"status":"ok","service":"ivx-owner-ai-backend","deploymentMarker":"ivx-owner-ai-hono-autodeploy-live (see commit+bootTime for freshness)"}
  ```
- `/health` currently returns healthy runtime data, including:
  ```text
  seniorDeveloperRuntime.enabled=true
  seniorDeveloperRuntime.github.canReadRepo=true
  seniorDeveloperRuntime.github.canPush=true
  seniorDeveloperRuntime.render.canDeploy=true
  seniorDeveloperRuntime.commitSha=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Existing backend crash-safe task orchestration test suite previously passed:
  ```text
  bun test backend/services/ivx-task-orchestrator.test.ts backend/services/operational-memory/engineering-intelligence.test.ts
  4 pass
  0 fail
  ```
- Verified existing task-state implementation in:
  ```text
  backend/services/ivx-task-state-store.ts
  backend/services/ivx-task-orchestrator.ts
  ```
  with atomic block updates, append-only events, resumable cursor, crash recovery, and approval statuses.
- Inspected `backend/services/operational-memory/engineering-intelligence.ts`; it defines incident area/severity types and states an intended `public.ivx_telemetry` plus operational-memory persistence strategy, but its deployment decision is advisory only.
- Inspected `.github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml`; it has `workflow_dispatch` and main push triggers, but trigger paths cover only a limited subset of backend/Expo/workflow files.
- Native scaffold repairs completed independently of Expo repository:
  ```text
  android-ivx-holdings/gradle/libs.versions.toml
  android-ivx-holdings/app/build.gradle.kts
  android-ivx-holdings/app/src/main/java/com/ivxholdings/app/ui/screens/OwnerDashboardScreen.kt
  ```
  - Added `io.ktor:ktor-client-logging`.
  - Restored local `ActionCard`.
  - Final Android release build check succeeded.

### In Progress
- Audit existing self-healing, incident persistence, containment, workflow, and recovery capabilities in small isolated batches.
- Reconcile the available local checkout SHA:
  ```text
  42fd09aec234452527c394d6602d50e9a1ae1c5c
  ```
  with production runtime SHA:
  ```text
  012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Establish current GitHub Actions workflow/run/runner evidence, CI-tested SHA, and GitHub remote `main` evidence before any repair branch.
- Revalidate the Expo Android release-version mismatch in a verified canonical checkout before creating a bounded fix.

### Blocked
- Current local GitHub API credentials are invalid:
  ```text
  curl --silent --show-error --fail-with-body --max-time 20 -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" ... https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
  {
    "message": "Bad credentials",
    "documentation_url": "https://docs.github.com/rest",
    "status": "401"
  }
  ```
- Current workflow-run inspection is therefore blocked:
  ```text
  https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/runs?per_page=10
  ```
  returns HTTP `401` / `Bad credentials`.
- The available local checkout is ahead of its configured Rork-router remote and cannot prove canonical GitHub `main`:
  ```text
  origin https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- No current evidence proves:
  ```text
  GitHub main SHA = CI tested SHA = Render deployed SHA = /health SHA = /version SHA
  ```
- Supabase log collection is unavailable because no Supabase backend is provisioned:
  ```text
  rork-agent logs supabase --since 2026-08-02T00:00:00Z
  Supabase backend not provisioned
  ```
- `/api/ivx/agent-jobs/status` requires authentication and returned:
  ```text
  IVX auth guard failed: missing bearer [redacted]
  ```
  with HTTP `401`; job/worker status cannot be assessed anonymously.
- No verified auto-fix branch, commit SHA, pushed PR URL, CI run ID, approval, merge, deployment ID, rollback result, or post-repair runtime evidence exists.
- No durable production incident ledger evidence was verified for all required fields: incident ID, trace ID, affected users, stack trace, production SHA, mitigation, and repair state.
- No active real-time crash-monitoring evidence was verified for Android, iOS, JavaScript, backend, Render restart loops, queue heartbeats, blank screens, memory exhaustion, upload/auth failures, or SHA mismatch.
- No verified automated containment, feature-flag disablement, rollback execution, or prior-release health verification exists.
- No heartbeat workflow, heartbeat run, or `RUNNER_HEARTBEAT_PASS` evidence exists.
- No required workflow has three consecutive successful runs from one verified SHA; branch protection required-status-check evidence remains unavailable.
- No controlled self-healing certification tests have run for TypeScript failure, API timeout, duplicate chat messages, failed deployment verification, or worker restart.
- Runtime/mobile crash evidence remains unavailable.
- Historical AI gateway upstream failures remain uncorrelated to a durable incident and recovery:
  ```text
  responseStatus":412
  "Precondition Failed"
  statusCode":503
  "Service temporarily unavailable"
  ```
- Production Android signing remains owner-protected:
  ```text
  IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE
  IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
  IVX_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS
  IVX_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Do not report `SELF_HEALING_ACTIVE_VERIFIED`; current evidence does not satisfy the requested acceptance conditions.
- Treat `/readiness`, `/health`, and `/version` as limited runtime observations, not GitHub/CI/deployment SHA-parity certification.
- Do not activate or simulate production rollback, deploy, secret, database, authentication, signing, or infrastructure changes without owner approval.
- Do not treat runtime-reported GitHub permissions as proof that the local `$GITHUB_TOKEN` is valid; local API calls currently return `401`.
- Keep repairs bounded: create `auto-fix/<incident-id>`, demonstrate a failing regression first, apply the smallest repair, validate, review, push, PR, CI, and approval-gated deployment.
- Do not use the current local checkout or Rork-router remote as proof of canonical GitHub `main` until authenticated remote state is captured.
- Keep `android-ivx-holdings/` separate from the canonical Expo Android production path.

## Next Steps
1. Restore a valid read-only GitHub credential and capture remote `main` SHA, branch protection, workflow definitions, run IDs, conclusions, tested SHAs, and runner evidence.
2. Reconcile GitHub `main`, local `42fd09aec234452527c394d6602d50e9a1ae1c5c`, and runtime `012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c` before any repository mutation.
3. Obtain authorized worker-status access for:
   ```text
   /api/ivx/agent-jobs/status
   ```
   and evaluate heartbeat, durable checkpoint, duplicate-prevention, and restart-resume evidence.
4. Establish valid Supabase access or document its absence; inspect actual telemetry/incident persistence schema rather than relying on source comments.
5. Inspect remaining operational-memory routes and tests for required incident fields, trace correlation, idempotency, checkpoint recovery, approval gates, containment, and SHA-parity gaps.
6. Re-run:
   ```text
   node expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs
   ```
   in a verified canonical checkout; if still failing, create exactly one isolated `auto-fix/<incident-id>` branch with regression coverage.
7. Create a minimal runner-heartbeat workflow in a branch/PR, printing `RUNNER_OS`, `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`, `GITHUB_REF`, and `RUNNER_HEARTBEAT_PASS`, without secrets.
8. Add only bounded non-production self-healing foundation changes after the audit: durable incident lifecycle, evidence capture, idempotency/checkpoint tests, and explicit approval gates.
9. Execute controlled fixtures only in isolated environments after incident ledger and PR/CI harnesses are available.
10. Require approval/merge, CI-tested SHA, deployment ID, `LIVE` status, `/health`, `/version`, smoke tests, runtime SHA equality, and rollback availability before marking any repair verified.

## Critical Context
- Production runtime SHA observed through `/health`:
  ```text
  012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Current available local checkout SHA:
  ```text
  42fd09aec234452527c394d6602d50e9a1ae1c5c
  ```
- `/health` reports a live runtime credential capability, but this does not authorize production deployment or prove local credential validity.
- `backend/services/operational-memory/engineering-intelligence.ts` explicitly states:
  ```text
  this module never deploys, reverts, or mutates files

  and treats deploy-gate output as advisory.
- `backend/services/ivx-task-state-store.ts` documents filesystem persistence under:

  ```
  Durable process-restart behavior was tested, but persistence across Render instance replacement or production worker restart is not proven.
- Existing `IVX CI` `push` path filters omit many repository areas; this prevents it alone from proving a complete-stack continuous scan.
- Earlier Expo Android version conflict remains historical until revalidated:

- Existing Expo Android QA identity must not be confused with that scaffold:

- `backend/services/ivx-task-orchestrator.ts`: crash-safe ordered task block executor with approval classification.

- `expo/app.config.ts`: established Expo application version source; revalidate before version repair.
- `expo/android/app/build.gradle`: historical Android release `versionName` mismatch repair target.
- `expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs`: validator for Expo config, Gradle version, and landing APK URLs.
- `android-ivx-holdings/gradle/libs.versions.toml`: native scaffold Ktor logging dependency was added.
